added_lines: what's planned? pumpkin carving. short catechetical/virtue talk for boys refreshments/treats. fathers' talk; sons' game why come along? strengthen the bond between father and son connect with like-minded catholic families enjoy a welcoming, faith-centred activity what to bring? one or more pumpkins per family. pumpkin carving tools, if available. old clothes. creativity and enthusiasm! organised by brosna educational centres weekly intentions, 10:00am: mon. 26th—31st october delia may & tom moran, moyvilla john murphy, the arch bar betty phillips nigel & michael mcghee, cullairbaun arthur & mary mcghee, loughrea phil & michael mooney, woodvillle annie briggs, her brothers tom, jack & bernard, coshla paddy flaherty, summerhill, athlone & belleville kieran glynn, caheroyan park john tully, barrack st. paddy brennan, northgate st. anthony coffey & deceased of the coffey family, ballybacka jacqueline morrissey, deerpark martin kennedy, athenry patrick conroy, mountpelier & all deceased members of the conroy & lynch families mattie & bridget kirwan & deceased family members bridget mongan, ballygurrane john, kay, peter & ann hession, mirah, turloughmore gerard & john hession, london gabriel amodia, london hymns — please join in 11am mass entrance: holy god we praise thy name offertory: be still for the presence of the lord communion: godhead here in hiding recessional: sweet saviour bliss holy god, we praise thy name! lord of all, we bow before thee all on earth thy sceptre claim, all in heav'n above adore thee; infinite thy vast domain, everlasting is thy reign. hark! the loud celestial hymn angel choirs above are raising! cherubim and seraphim, in unceasing chorus praising, fill the heav'ns with sweet accord; holy, holy, holy, lord! first holy communion 2027—grow in love the ‘grow in love’ parish programme revolves around the children & their families’ attendance at special monthly masses from all the national schools in athenry parish. remembering our beloved deceased in athenry parish november 2026 athenry
